percentile_definition: Linear interpolation: h=(n-1)*p, quantile=x[floor(h)]+(h-floor(h))*(x[ceil(h)]-x[floor(h)]), p=0.025 and 0.975; NumPy percentile method=linear.
bootstrap_unit: task: preserve all three rounds; resample 76 task clusters with replacement

same_task_success_normal_failure_pairing.selection: Task has at least one resolved attempt and one unresolved attempt with failure_kind == none. Execution-error failures in those tasks are excluded from paired comparison.
same_task_success_normal_failure_pairing.exact_loop_definition: At least 5 consecutive tool calls with identical function name and complete json.dumps(arguments, sort_keys=True), ordered by call timestamp, across all authors.
same_task_success_normal_failure_pairing.near_loop_definition: Same as legacy loop_calls: function name plus first 80 characters of sorted JSON arguments; this can group different full arguments.

reference_environment: vllm/vllm-openai:v0.19.1 image (Python 3.12) + competition wheelhouse + Dockerfile.sandbox base test tools; subprocess sandbox; checked 2026-09-29
reference_interpretation: Reference-patch pass/fail in the recorded environment, not proof of intrinsic task solvability or official-server behavior. Missing-module attribution is restricted to listed modules.

timeout.association_not_tested_reason: Failure status is outcome-related; retain decomposition and conditional restart estimates only.

context_window.association_not_tested_reason: Failure status is outcome-related; retain decomposition and conditional restart estimates only.

normal_failure.association_not_tested_reason: Failure status is outcome-related; retain decomposition and conditional restart estimates only.

successful_edit_error_claim_audit.identification_reason: All 228 edit and schema counts agree exactly with legacy attempts.json. Legacy summary only reports failed attempts; no 19-success definition or row set was supplied.

denominator_distortion.definition: p = successes/attempts. q = successes among all ordered distinct attempt pairs whose first attempt failed. No outcomes observed for 53 excluded tasks; zero-imputation illustrates measurement distortion only.

ghost_costs.causal_cost_identification_reason: Per-call dispatch and observation timestamps identify response latency; preceding event gaps also include generation, scheduling and intervening work. No no-error counterfactual or generation-start timestamps identify total causal error cost.
ghost_costs.counter_identification_reason: Traces expose rejected calls and final counted tool calls but no per-call budget counter transitions. Rejected-call count is observed; counter-exclusion mechanism needs harness source corroboration.
ghost_costs.llm_minus_tool_interpretation: Includes successful delegation and text-only calls; not a ghost-call count.

queue.policy: Broad-first rounds 1,2,3, skipping solved tasks; bootstrap resamples and permutes task order. Trigger is kth consecutive error-bearing tool step, reset by any nonmatching tool step; text/system steps do not reset. Triggered attempt treated as unsuccessful; final patch at earlier trigger not tested.
queue.measured_support: Observed attempts were capped at 600 seconds with termination overhead. Replay truncates overhead to 600. No 60-minute trajectories are observed.
queue.breaker_is_simulation: Trigger times and removed suffixes observed; changed outcomes and extra queued completions are replay assumptions, not measured online gains.
queue.60min_assumptions: Only timed_out attempts extend to exactly 3600 seconds; all other durations/outcomes unchanged. Late success is Bernoulli at 3600 seconds with stated probability. No early late-success timing modeled; no recovery effects inferred from observed data.
queue.actual_60min_identification_reason: No outcomes or event history beyond observed 600-second cap.

redacted_table_contract.attempts: All 228 rows preserve task clusters, outcomes, error counts, runtime, failure and loop flags, observed error latencies, and all evaluated breaker triggers; enough to recompute p/q, exposure associations, conditional restart and queue simulation without private traces.
redacted_table_contract.events: Edit-error event times only; no code, prompts, arguments or observation text. Sums reproduce observed latency and event-gap aggregates.
redacted_table_contract.reference: 129 reference outcomes and module labels, enough to recompute repository audit.
redacted_table_contract.draws: 1000 paired task-bootstrap queue draws per policy, enough to independently summarize queue means, percentile intervals and paired differences. Statistical rate and exposure intervals require rerunning seeded task bootstrap on attempts.
redacted_table_contract.trace_hashes: Per task and round SHA256 manifest validates private raw sources without exporting them.

inference_notes: Fisher p-values ignore within-task dependence and are descriptive only; task bootstrap and within-task sign test handle task clustering.
Exposure is post-treatment and may reflect task difficulty or trajectory duration; association is not causal.
Multiple error modalities overlap; no multiple-testing-adjusted claims made.
Chronological next-round rates and unordered repeat-pair rates are distinct estimands.
